description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You touch one unattended object of up to 10 Bulk, or a 10-foot cube of a structure. It is destroyed, its atoms parted and scattered as a fine glittering dust.

This cannot destroy artifacts, Cloths, or objects of similar significance. Against a creature's attended object, that creature may attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC to pull it clear.

On any day your constellation is ascendant or Exalted, this has no frequency limit and its size limit increases to 40 Bulk or a 20-foot cube.

Granted by the Atomic Dissolution feat.
